sloka: सत्यं राक्षसराजेन्द्र शृणुष्व वचनं मम ।रामदासस्य दृतस्य वानरस्य विशेषतः ।। ५.५१.३८।।।।
transliteration: satyaṁ rākṣasarājendra śṛṇuṣva vacanaṁ mama ।rāmadāsasya dṛtasya vānarasya viśeṣataḥ ।। 5.51.38।।।।

translations.english: "O king of demon listen to the words of truth of the servant of Rama, his messenger and specially a vanara.
